nodes.label: Huginn Raven Brand Identity
nodes.rationale: Raven named after Huginn (Odin's raven of thought) - a watcher/observer metaphor; teal/dark-green body with neon lime-green accents.

nodes.label: Radar + Circuit Trace Motif
nodes.rationale: Radar sweep on the raven's wing with circuit traces conveys monitoring/scanning/surveillance tech purpose.

nodes.label: Prometheus huginn scrape job (/metrics on huginn-api:8080)
nodes.norm_label: prometheus huginn scrape job (/metrics on huginn-api:8080)

nodes.label: LLM_SOCKS5_PROXY dedicated outbound LLM proxy
nodes.rationale: Applied only to LLM HTTP transport, not generic HTTP_PROXY, so internal Docker traffic never routes through Xray.

nodes.label: LLM json_object structured output mode
nodes.rationale: deepseek-v4-flash rejects response_format json_schema (HTTP 400), so json_object with explicit JSON contract and structural validation is used.

nodes.label: Modular monolith with async workers (huginn-api, huginn-worker, huginn-cli)
nodes.norm_label: modular monolith with async workers (huginn-api, huginn-worker, huginn-cli)

nodes.label: Dashboard index.html (RTL fa shell, Vazirmatn font, /src/main.tsx)
nodes.norm_label: dashboard index.html (rtl fa shell, vazirmatn font, /src/main.tsx)

nodes.label: MockHuginnApi (test-only)
nodes.rationale: No mock backend in runtime builds; mock lives only in unit tests.

nodes.label: React + TypeScript + Vite + TanStack + React Hook Form/Zod
nodes.norm_label: react + typescript + vite + tanstack + react hook form/zod

nodes.label: TP Light/Dark design tokens (Adobe Spectrum inspired)
nodes.norm_label: tp light/dark design tokens (adobe spectrum inspired)

nodes.label: Hand-rolled RTL-aware SVG/CSS charts
nodes.rationale: Guarantee RTL correctness and keep bundle lean.

nodes.label: Frontend permission gating mirroring backend RBAC
nodes.norm_label: frontend permission gating mirroring backend rbac
nodes.rationale: Frontend permissions are never source of truth; actions still gated server-side.

nodes.label: Explicit dev mock layer (VITE_USE_MOCK_API, src/mocks)
nodes.rationale: Mock is opt-in only; production code never contains demo records.

nodes.label: Persian RTL-first i18n
nodes.rationale: RTL never faked with ad-hoc CSS; charts mirror x-axis.

nodes.label: Lead table state in URL
nodes.rationale: Managers can share filtered views.

nodes.label: core/external Intent launchers (CallLauncher, SmsLauncher, MessengerLauncher, EmailLauncher, ContactInsertLauncher)
nodes.norm_label: core/external intent launchers (calllauncher, smslauncher, messengerlauncher, emaillauncher, contactinsertlauncher)
nodes.rationale: Single place Intents are created; ViewModels never build Intents.

nodes.label: Minimal permission inventory (INTERNET, POST_NOTIFICATIONS, RECORD_AUDIO)
nodes.rationale: Huginn never reads personal contacts, SMS, call logs or mail; uses system Intents instead. Verified by ManifestPermissionsTest.

nodes.label: No local cache fallback for leads/work queue
nodes.norm_label: no local cache fallback for leads/work queue
nodes.rationale: Show typed network error rather than stale or fabricated data.

nodes.label: No automatic sending (contact actions only prepare messages/deep links)
nodes.norm_label: no automatic sending (contact actions only prepare messages/deep links)

nodes.label: Huginn pre-CRM sales intelligence platform
nodes.rationale: Huginn is not a CRM; it ends where Muninn begins and transfers only qualified leads.

nodes.label: Ingestion data flow (Import -> MinIO -> RabbitMQ -> Worker -> Tika -> LLM -> Dedup -> Scoring -> Assignment -> Qualification -> Outbox -> Muninn)
nodes.norm_label: ingestion data flow (import -> minio -> rabbitmq -> worker -> tika -> llm -> dedup -> scoring -> assignment -> qualification -> outbox -> muninn)

nodes.label: LLM-driven contact backfill (make backfill-contacts)
nodes.rationale: Fills only empty fields; never overwrites manual corrections or creates duplicates.

nodes.label: LLM as sole authority for contact extraction/association
nodes.norm_label: llm as sole authority for contact extraction/association
nodes.rationale: Deterministic logic only cleans artifacts, validates/normalizes, and emits recovery_signal_only warnings; never overrides LLM contact values.

nodes.label: LLM safety: untrusted documents, strict schema, repair retry
nodes.norm_label: llm safety: untrusted documents, strict schema, repair retry

nodes.label: Muninn export outbox pattern with idempotency
nodes.norm_label: muninn export outbox pattern with idempotency

nodes.label: Mandatory contact report workflow (Android)
nodes.rationale: Most important mobile workflow: app blocks navigation until report is submitted; backend is source of truth so it survives process death.

nodes.label: Room offline pending_report_queue + WorkManager retry
nodes.rationale: Locally queued reports are never treated as completed until backend confirms.

nodes.label: Mandatory report enforcement (MANDATORY_REPORT_PENDING, manager override)
nodes.rationale: Completed contact action requires a report; only audited manager override can void.

nodes.label: RefreshInterceptor (single-flight 401 refresh)
nodes.rationale: Single-flight refresh prevents concurrent refresh storms; revoked refresh clears session to login.

nodes.label: JWT access + rotating hashed refresh tokens
nodes.norm_label: jwt access + rotating hashed refresh tokens

nodes.label: graphify knowledge graph usage rules
nodes.rationale: Use scoped graphify query/path/explain before raw grep or GRAPH_REPORT to keep context small; run graphify update after code changes.

nodes.label: Persian company directory test fixture (manufacturers/distributors 1403)
nodes.rationale: Raw Persian market data with phones/mobiles/emails used to test LLM extraction and normalization.

nodes.label: Explicit degraded call-scenario fallback (generation_status, fallback_used)
nodes.rationale: Degradation is explicit never silent; clients must not present template content as AI-generated.

nodes.label: Lead detail permissions/workflow hints
nodes.rationale: So Android, PWA and admin clients never reimplement business rules.
